validator.check_scope: validate checks one file: it takes a single transcript.md. The umbrella command checks every record in a workspace.

codes.means: The file is not valid UTF-8, so its header cannot be read.
codes.fix: Re-save the file as UTF-8 from its original bytes.

codes.means: The header opens with --- but has no well-formed opening or closing --- line.
codes.fix: Put --- alone on the first line and on the line that ends the header.

codes.means: A header line is not one snake_case key, a colon, a space and a value.
codes.fix: Write each header line as `key: <compact JSON>`.

codes.means: The header uses __proto__, prototype or constructor as a key.
codes.fix: Remove or rename that key.

codes.means: A key appears twice, at the top level or inside a JSON value.
codes.fix: Keep one occurrence of the key.

codes.means: A header value is not valid JSON.
codes.fix: Write the value as compact JSON (strings quoted).

codes.means: A header value is not plain JSON data (a non-finite number, a cycle, a non-plain object).
codes.fix: Use only JSON strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays and objects.

codes.means: A value does not satisfy the conversation schema.
codes.fix: Correct the field to the type and values the schema allows.

codes.means: A field the schema requires is missing.
codes.fix: Add the field; use null or unknown where the fact is not known.

codes.means: A field the schema does not declare is present.
codes.fix: Remove it, or move it under extensions.

codes.means: The record names no standard, the bare unversioned URL (written before versions), or a value that is not a conversation standard version.
codes.fix: transcript-md stamp-standard --workspace . --apply

codes.means: The record names a version of the conversation standard this package does not implement.
codes.fix: Install a @supersuit/transcript-md that implements that version.

codes.means: schema_version is not 1.
codes.fix: Read it with a package that supports that schema version.

codes.means: The record id, or a record-id alias, is not a portable directory name.
codes.fix: Use an NFC id with no slash, control character or trailing space or dot.

codes.means: The record id differs from the name of the folder holding it.
codes.fix: Rename the folder or the id so they match.

codes.means: A new record id is not lowercase kebab case.
codes.fix: Choose an id like `team-call-2026-10-20`.

codes.means: A new record has no intended reader.
codes.fix: Set audience.

codes.means: A fact is recorded as unknown (null or unknown).
codes.fix: Fill it in when it becomes known; nothing is wrong meanwhile.

codes.means: date or as_of is not a real calendar day.
codes.fix: Write YYYY-MM-DD for a day that exists.

codes.means: An instant is not RFC 3339 with seconds and a timezone offset.
start has neither a local time nor an instant.
codes.fix: Give start.local or start.instant, or set start to null.

codes.means: start.local is not a real clock time.
codes.fix: Write HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

codes.means: start.timezone is not a valid IANA timezone name.
codes.fix: Use a name like America/New_York.

codes.means: Second precision is declared but start.local has no seconds.
codes.fix: Add seconds to start.local or lower the precision.

codes.means: date, local start, timezone and instant disagree.
codes.fix: Correct whichever of them is wrong.

codes.means: keep.group is not a workspace-relative path.
codes.fix: Use a relative path with no traversal.

codes.means: Family sharing names no group.
codes.fix: Set keep.group.

codes.means: Family sharing has no explicit operator decision.
codes.fix: Record the operator-decision evidence in keep.decision.

codes.means: Sharing has no explicit operator decision.
codes.fix: Record the operator-decision evidence in keep.decision.

codes.means: Two participants, sources, retired turns or protected turns share an id.
codes.fix: Give each a unique id.

codes.means: A participant of unknown status names a person.
codes.fix: Set person to null, or confirm the identity with evidence.

codes.means: A confirmed participant has no person or no identifying evidence.
codes.fix: Add the person and the evidence, or lower the status.

codes.means: A cloud recording lacks its service or recording id, or carries a vendor id.
codes.fix: Set service and recording_id; set vendor_id to null.

codes.means: A service locator names a different recording than its cloud capture.
codes.fix: Make the locator service_id equal the capture recording_id.

codes.means: A non-cloud capture carries cloud identity fields.
codes.fix: Set service and recording_id to null.

codes.means: A capture has no roles or repeats one.
codes.fix: List each role once, at least one.

codes.means: A locator carries identifiers that do not apply to its kind.
codes.fix: Service locators use url or service_id; others use path only.

codes.means: A bundled locator path is absolute or traverses.
codes.fix: Use a path relative to the record folder.

codes.means: A locator media_type is not a MIME type.
codes.fix: Write type/subtype, e.g. audio/mp4.

codes.means: An unverified backup claims verification fields.
codes.fix: Null them, or mark the backup verified-owned.

codes.means: An owned backup lacks a distinct locator, a matching checksum or a verification instant.
codes.fix: Record all three, or mark it unverified.

codes.means: A source-id alias has no namespace, or another alias has one.
codes.fix: Give namespaces to source-id aliases only.

codes.means: A citation lacks a relative path or a portable record id.
codes.fix: Correct the citation path and record_id.

codes.means: A git citation names no repository.
codes.fix: Set repository.

codes.means: A line citation ends before it starts.
codes.fix: Order start and end.

codes.means: A turn citation has no turn ids or repeats one.
codes.fix: List distinct turn ids.

codes.means: A cited capture span ends without an ordered start.
codes.fix: Give start_ms no later than end_ms.

codes.means: A path connection is not relative.
codes.fix: Use a workspace-relative path.

codes.means: Human review is claimed without operator-decision evidence.
codes.fix: Add the evidence, or mark it unreviewed.

codes.means: The retained legacy header bytes and their hash are missing in part or disagree.
codes.fix: Keep both, matching, or both null.

codes.means: A protected turn retains no reviewed versions.
codes.fix: Restore its reviewed versions from the revision journal.

codes.means: A reviewed version has no review dimensions or repeats one.
codes.fix: List each dimension once.

codes.means: A reviewed version entry path is not relative.
codes.fix: Use the record-relative path.

codes.means: An authorized change to a protected turn has no operator decision.
codes.fix: Record the operator-decision evidence.

codes.means: A <id>/transcript.md has no header at all.
codes.fix: Add the conversation header between --- lines.

codes.means: A conversation-redirect header has keys other than schema_version, kind and to, or a body.
codes.fix: Keep exactly schema_version 1, kind and a nonempty to, with an empty body.

codes.means: The body does not have exactly ## Now, ## Transcript, ## Log and ## Open questions, in that order.
codes.fix: Restore the four H2 sections, exactly spelled, in order.

codes.means: The body has more than one H1, or an H1 that differs from the header title.
codes.fix: Keep at most one H1, equal to title.

codes.means: No transcript section was found in the body.
codes.fix: Add a ## Transcript section when the words are available.

codes.means: The transcript section holds no words.
codes.fix: Nothing is wrong; add the words when they exist.

codes.means: A heading names a turn but is not `### t-NNNNNN`.
codes.fix: Write turn headings as ### t-000001.

codes.means: The transcript section has text before its first turn.
codes.fix: Move that text into a turn or into another section.

codes.means: Two turns share an id.
codes.fix: Give each turn a unique t-NNNNNN id.

codes.means: A turn heading is not followed by a `<!-- turn {...} -->` line with exactly speaker, sources, timing and source_gap.
codes.fix: Put the turn metadata comment directly under the heading.

codes.means: A turn speaker is not one of the participants.
codes.fix: Use a participant id, or null when the speaker is unknown.

codes.means: A turn has neither sources nor a written source_gap, or a blank gap.
codes.fix: Cite the capture span, or explain the gap in source_gap.

codes.means: A turn timing does not fit its declared captures and mappings.
codes.fix: Correct the timing, or set it to null.

codes.means: A turn has no known speaker.
codes.fix: Map the speaker to a participant when known.

codes.means: A turn has no timing.
codes.fix: Add timing when a capture mapping exists.

codes.means: A turn records a source gap instead of a capture span.
codes.fix: Cite the capture span when it becomes available.

codes.means: A turn holds no words.
codes.fix: Add its words, or retire the turn.

codes.means: The record lists no source captures.
codes.fix: Add the capture the words came from when known.

codes.means: The record lists no participants.
codes.fix: Add the participants when known.

codes.means: The file or record does not exist.
codes.fix: Check the path or id.

codes.means: The record or its workspace could not be read completely.
codes.fix: Check the path, the workspace and file permissions, then retry.

codes.means: Redirects lead back to a record already visited.
codes.fix: Point the redirect at the final record.

codes.means: A redirect leads to something that is not a canonical <id>/transcript.md.
codes.fix: Point the redirect at a canonical record.

codes.means: A redirect cannot be followed without an explicit workspace.
codes.fix: Pass --workspace.

codes.means: More than eight redirects in a row.
codes.fix: Point the first redirect straight at the final record.

codes.means: A redirect, or a requested path, leaves the workspace.
codes.fix: Use a workspace-relative target.

codes.means: A symlink in the transcripts folder was not followed.
codes.fix: Replace the link with the real file or folder.

codes.means: A Markdown file sits where no conversation record can be.
codes.fix: Move it, or into a <id>/transcript.md.

codes.means: Two records have ids that are equal after Unicode case folding.
codes.fix: Rename one of them.

codes.means: An alias or id resolves to more than one record.
codes.fix: Remove or narrow the duplicate alias.

codes.means: A legacy header line or field could not be read as a flat key and value.
codes.fix: Correct the line, or migrate the record to a canonical header.

codes.means: A legacy header gives more than one date.
codes.fix: Keep one date.

codes.means: A legacy recording names no recognised service.
codes.fix: Name the service, or migrate and record the capture explicitly.

codes.means: A legacy recording has no usable recording id.
codes.fix: Add the exact recording id.

codes.means: A legacy source names a role that is not recognised.
codes.fix: Use a recognised role, or migrate the record.

codes.means: A legacy header has time fields the reader will not interpret as a start.
codes.fix: Migrate the record and state start explicitly.

codes.means: A legacy privacy or sharing field could not be interpreted; the record is treated as private.
codes.fix: Migrate the record and set keep explicitly.

codes.means: The command line is not one the CLI accepts.
codes.fix: Run transcript-md --help for the exact flags.
